{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_patients = trial['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Count how many times each patient_id appears
duplicate_counts = trial['patient_id'].value_counts()

print(f"Total duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1].count()}")
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")"}
